title: Letter from the Demonic Path
next_chapter_hook: When Ye Qing uttered that name, the teacup in Chen Ji's hand shattered silently—Ling Yuan, that hypocritical old man, had actually been her Shishu? How would this dust-laden past overturn the entire chess game of the Tianqing Sect?

text.content: Night inked in black, cold crows fell silent. Chen Ji sat alone on the dilapidated wooden bed in the Servants' Quarters, clutching the jade slip still bearing warmth. Though the pursuing enemy's fragmented soul had been annihilated, those memory fragments coiled like dormant venomous serpents within his Mental Sea, flickering tongues that sent chills through his spine. The Tianji Record fragment in his divine sense radiated gentle heat, its small characters seeming to urge: Heavenly Fate Value 5, three hours of foresight. Yet he had no mood to peer into the future at this moment. Because what he had just witnessed was a net already woven—and he was merely a moth that thought itself clever, trapped upon it.

dialogue.content: (Fingertips tapping the table lightly, gaze deep as an ancient well) Mo Xiansheng, since you've always hidden within the first page, shouldn't some things be made clear now? The Eye of Heavenly Secrets... what exactly is it?

text.content: The first page of the Tianji Record flickered with faint light, and that familiar fragmentary soul phantom gradually emerged. Mo Xiansheng's voice remained ethereal, yet carried an unusual gravity: 'Young Master, some truths, known too early, are not necessarily blessings. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets... it is not merely an organization or faction as you might think.' The phantom paused briefly, 'It is a fragment of this world's will, a projection of Heaven's self-awareness. Every prophet throughout history, including you and me, are merely pieces on its chessboard.'

dialogue.content: (The fragmentary soul phantom trembled slightly) This old one can only tell you this much. If Young Master wishes to survive, you must grow strong enough that it cannot manipulate you at will, before the Eye of Heavenly Secrets discovers you have seen through the truth. In seven days, a variable will appear... that is the final lifeline this old one has secured for you.

text.content: Before the words finished, a faint wind chime drifted through the window. Chen Ji's gaze sharpened—that was the signal he and Ye Qing had agreed upon—three short notes followed by one long one, meaning urgent intelligence. He pushed open the window frame composedly. A jet-black paper crane hovered beneath the eaves, its eyes inlaid with blood-red gemstones that gleamed under the moonlight. This was a unique messenger artifact of the Demonic Path, utterly undetectable to ordinary cultivators.

dialogue.content: (A cold female voice emerged from the paper crane—it was Ye Qing) Chen Ji, the seven-day agreement has been moved up. The Holy Maiden will personally arrive at the outer regions of Tianqing Sect in three days. You must appear then. The conditions she brings... are more tempting and more dangerous than you can imagine. Additionally, I've discovered a secret about Ling Yuan—we'll discuss the details in person.

text.content: After completing its message, the paper crane dissolved into a thin talisman. On its surface was clearly drawn an eye-like seal—the mark of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, yet tinged with an eerie purple-black sheen. Chen Ji tucked the talisman into his sleeve, his heart already churning with tumultuous waves. Three days. The seven-day agreement had been moved up by four days. What did this mean? Had there been a change within the Demonic Path, or... was someone pulling strings from behind the scenes? He walked slowly to the window, his gaze piercing the heavy night, toward the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak. There,灯火通明, Ling Yuan's quarters were still celebrating the post-banquet.

Ling Yuan's secret... Chen Ji suddenly recalled that in the memory fragments of the pursuer, he had glimpsed a blurry scene: young Ling Yuan standing in a dim stone chamber, before him knelt several robed cultivators in black, and the chamber's layout bore a striking resemblance to the Council Hall of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. At the time, he had assumed Ling Yuan was gathering intelligence on the Demonic Path, but now upon careful reflection, the way those black-robed cultivators looked at Ling Yuan was clearly the reverence of subordinates toward their lord, not the wariness between enemies.

dialogue.content: (A cold smile curved at the corner of his lips) How interesting. Old fox, you've hidden deep enough. Three days... three days is enough time for me to do many things.

choice.prompt: With the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path imminent and Ye Qing's message concealing deeper meanings, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Take the initiative to investigate Ling Yuan's relationship with the Demonic Path first
choices.description: Before the Holy Maiden arrives, use the Tianji Record to peer into Ling Yuan's secrets. If he truly has ties to the Demonic Path, he becomes a piece that can be used for leverage.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key leverage against Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate value drops too low, it will trigger a deadly backlash, and the Tianji Record's aura may be detected by Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his fingertips gently touching the Tianji Record fragment. In an instant, an arcane rune materialized between his brows, and his consciousness plummeted into a chaotic mist. Within the next three hours, every move Ling Yuan made would be laid bare before his eyes. The image gradually sharpened—it was three nights prior, Ling Yuan had walked alone into the Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, clutching an ancient bronze casket. Deep within the forbidden area, a black-robed elder came forward to greet him—turned out to be a护法长老 of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path! The two stood facing each other. Ling Yuan presented the casket, whispering: 'The items the Holy Maiden requires have been prepared. When the time comes, I hope the Holy One will speak well of this one before the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.'

choices.text: Hold position and quietly wait for the Holy Maiden to arrive to understand her intentions
choices.description: Do not easily expose your own abilities. Continue to numb everyone present with thetrash persona, and make your decision only after the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path reveals her cards.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the first-mover advantage, maintain information asymmetry
choices.visible_reward: Preserve persona integrity, avoid打草惊蛇
choices.risk_hint: If the Holy Maiden and Ling Yuan join forces to set a trap, you may fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his fingers, forcibly suppressing the Tianji Record's agitation. Heavenly Fate was his greatest trump card—unless absolutely necessary, it must never be easily consumed. Moreover, his current 'trash' identity was precisely the best camouflage. He turned and lay back on the wooden bed, crossing his legs with an air of complete indifference. Yet deep within those narrowed eyes, a cold light flickered—just for a moment. At the chess game in three days, he wanted to see exactly how many people intended to use him as a piece.

choices.text: Secretly contact Su Qingyao to probe her attitude toward Ling Yuan
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only one who noticed something wrong with Chen Ji, and perhaps she also harbors suspicions about Ling Yuan. But once her intentions are exposed, the consequences are unpredictable.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's stance is unclear; she may report to Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji took out a jade talisman from under his pillow—Su Qingyao had secretly slipped it to him three days ago, said to be a passage token for Inner Disciples. After hesitating for a moment, he injected a thread of divine sense into the talisman. Shortly after, Su Qingyao's cold voice came through: "Chen Ji? Calling late at night, you have quite the nerve. Speak, what's the matter?" He lowered his voice: "Senior Sister Su, I want to ask you something—do you think Sect Master Ling is trustworthy?" There was a full three breaths of silence on the other end before she answered: "...Tomorrow at dawn, meet me under the old locust tree on the Back Mountain."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶对凌渊似乎也有疑虑

text.content: Three days passed in a flash. On a secluded cliff platform at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back. Below, clouds churned like a sea, and in the distance, the outlines of three major sects loomed faintly. A gentle breeze brushed past, stirring his faded cyan robe of a Servant Disciple, but couldn't disperse the heavy solemnity gathering between his brows. Today, the Demon Path Holy Maiden arrives in person. Ye Qing's figure emerged silently from the Void, her face veiled in black silk, wisps of purple mist swirling around her form. Her gaze toward Chen Ji was complex and difficult to discern—harboring the tacit understanding between allies, yet also carrying an inexplicable, evaluative scrutiny.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing stepped forward, lowering her voice) Chen Ji, I've investigated the matter you asked me to look into. Ling Yuan... fifty years ago, he cultivated for three years in the Demon Path Holy Sect. His master-disciple lineage carries countless, inextricable ties to our Demon Path Holy Sect.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered subtly, but his expression remained unmoved. He recalled the scene he had glimpsed in the pursuing soldier's memory fragments—young Ling Yuan receiving the worship of thousands in the Demon Path Council Hall, that grand display, that imposing aura, far beyond what an ordinary exchange disciple could possess. Moreover, Ye Qing had just used the word "master-disciple lineage." In the cultivation world, this implies inheritance, bloodline, and... brotherhood between fellow disciples. He spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Lady Ye Qing, exactly what relationship do you have with Ling Yuan?"

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing fell silent for a long while before finally raising her head, revealing eyes glowing with faint purple light) Chen Ji, what I'm about to say, you must forget after hearing it. Ling Yuan... is my Shishu (maternal uncle/master's junior brother). Fifty years ago, he infiltrated Tianqing Sect as a hidden agent and never returned. And my master, the Holy Son of that era, was the one he personally betrayed, meeting a fate of death and the destruction of his cultivation.

text.content: With these words spoken, the last trace of Chen Ji's hope vanished completely. Ling Yuan, Demon Path Holy Sect hidden agent, betrayer of fellow disciples, defector from the righteous path... if these charges were proven, the entire Tianqing Sect would become a laughingstock in the cultivation world. And Chen Ji's position in this chess game would change fundamentally. What alarmed him even more was—if Ye Qing knew all this, why only tell him today? Was the grudge between her and Ling Yuan merely the tip of the iceberg? In the distance, a purple-black light tore through the sky, accompanied by a low horn blast—the Demon Path Holy Maiden's procession had officially arrived.

choice.prompt: The Demon Path Holy Maiden has arrived, and Ye Qing has confessed her connection to Ling Yuan. At this moment when forces converge, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Form a death alliance with Ye Qing and jointly deal with Ling Yuan
choices.description: Ye Qing's grudge is the strongest motivation; with her help, there will be one more chance of success against Ling Yuan. But this means completely taking the Demon Path's side.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the Demon Path's name may result in righteous faction encirclement and suppression
choices.visible_reward: Obtain support from a Demon Path Holy Maiden-level ally
choices.risk_hint: Is Ye Qing completely trustworthy? What is the Holy Sect behind her scheming?

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's purple-glowing eyes, then suddenly extended his hand: "Lady Ye Qing, from this day forward, you and I are death allies bound in the same boat. Ling Yuan's life, I'll keep for you—but the one who finally strikes the blow must be you." Ye Qing froze for an instant, then extended her slender fingers and lightly struck his palm: "Deal. Until death do us part." Purple-black mist surged between the two, and at this moment, something transcending mere interest was quietly forged.

choices.memory_label: 与夜清结成死盟，共同复仇

choices.text: Maintain observation and wait, first to see the game between the Holy Maiden and Ling Yuan
choices.description: The premise of borrowing power is seeing the situation clearly. Before Ye Qing and Ling Yuan officially tear off their masks, Chen Ji decided to remain still and gather more intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity for forming an alliance
choices.visible_reward: Preserve room for maneuver, not bound to any one side
choices.risk_hint: If the situation changes drastically, may end up empty-handed on both sides

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand and said calmly: "Lady Ye Qing, your grudge is noted. But before Ling Yuan meets his end, I want to see what the Holy Maiden's purpose is in coming in person." Ye Qing's brow slightly furrowed, seemingly disappointed by his cautiousness, but she ultimately didn't force the issue: "As you wish. But remember, the Demon Path's patience is limited—within three days, you must give me an answer." With that, her form dissolved into the Void once more, leaving only a faint lingering fragrance.

The purple-black light grew closer and closer, transforming into a pitch-black Xuan Phoenix, pulling an ancient bronze war chariot that slowly descended from the Nine Heavens. Upon the chariot sat a graceful figure behind pearl curtains—her features invisible, yet one could sense a terrifying pressure sweeping over like a tide. That was the aura of Nascent Soul Stage, a true peak existence of the cultivation world. Within Tianqing Sect, bells and drums rang in unison as Ling Yuan led the elders and disciples to greet her in person, their attitude so恭敬, so almost humiliating. Chen Ji hid among the crowd, watching coldly, a sarcastic curve playing at the corner of his mouth. What a righteous leader, what a respected elder—yet fawning so shamelessly before the Demon Path Holy Maiden. How many unspeakable secrets lie hidden behind such a venerable facade?

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan smiled warmly, bowing deeply) "Your Highness the Holy Maiden honors us with your presence—old Ling failed to greet you properly from afar! I wonder what brings Your Highness here on this visit? Whatever Tianqing Sect can accomplish, this old man shall spare no effort, never refusing!"

text.content: Behind the bead curtain came a languid yet authoritative female voice: "Ling Yuan, you flatter me. I have come for two reasons: first, to fulfill the agreement made seven days ago; second..." The voice paused slightly, carrying a meaningful smile, "to meet that legendary inheritor of the Tianji Record—Chen Ji."

The words sent shockwaves through the crowd.

The Tianji Record? That worthless Chen Ji who couldn't even match a servant disciple? The Demonic Path's Saint had actually requested to see this person?

Ling Yuan's expression instantly darkened, his gaze sweeping across the crowd like a venomous snake before fixing on Chen Ji. He clearly hadn't anticipated that the Demonic Path's Saint would take such interest in a contemptible wretch.

Yet Chen Ji, under everyone's watchful eyes, slowly stepped out from the crowd. He walked unsteadily, his face filled with fear—a perfect picture of someone scared out of their wits—except for that cold, mocking glint hidden deep within his downcast eyes.

The real show was just beginning.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji trembled as he knelt on the ground, his voice shaking) D-Disciple Chen Ji greets Your Highness, the Saint... I wonder why Your Highness has summoned this disciple? This disciple is merely a waste who tends the fires and does odd jobs—how could I possibly know anything about the Tianji Record...

choice.prompt: The Saint had requested to see Chen Ji, and every gaze in the arena converged upon him. At this critical moment, Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond to this sudden attention:

choices.text: Continue pretending to be a fool, playing the role of a waste to the end
choices.description: Let everyone believe the Saint has come to the wrong person, use the contrast to slap the Demonic Path's intelligence network in the face, while buying time for Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: The crowd's contempt shifts to the Saint, slapping the Demonic Path intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: Since the Saint has made a direct request, she must have evidence—continuing the pretense may be exposed on the spot

text.content:
Behind the bead curtain, the Saint gave a light laugh—the sound like silver bells yet carrying bone-deep chill: "Waste? Chen Ji, my intelligence network never errs. Three days ago, you used the Tianji Record to kill pursuers from the Xuanwu Sect, and that scene was witnessed by quite a few." She waved her hand, and a screen of light materialized in the air—a projection of that moment when Chen Ji had channeled the Tianji Record, his eyes blazing with mysterious light!

The crowd erupted again, and this time even Ling Yuan's expression became extraordinarily complex. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, a flash of fear in his eyes—just how deep had this "waste" been hiding?

choices.text: Seize the opportunity to admit it, then turn the tables by questioning the Saint's true intentions
choices.description: Since continued concealment is impossible, might as well proactively admit it, then turn to question the relationship between the Demonic Path's Saint and Ling Yuan, disrupting both sides' rhythm
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose his identity, losing the advantage of his disguise
choices.visible_reward: Publicly expose the suspicions of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Without solid evidence, he might instead be branded with a false accusation

text.content: Chen Ji's fearful expression suddenly vanished. He slowly rose to his feet, his gaze calm as he looked toward the battle chariot: "Since Your Highness already knows, then I shall no longer conceal it." He pivoted, "But there is something I do not understand—Your Highness keeps saying you wish to cooperate with me, but does Your Highness know that Ling Yuan, the Tianqing Sect's leader, is an old acquaintance of your sect's Law Enforcement Elder?" At these words, Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically, while the Saint arched an eyebrow with evident interest: "Oh? You are well-informed indeed. Continue."

Chen Ji stood in the center of the arena, facing the Demonic Path Saint's gaze, Ling Yuan's blade-like stare, and the startled murmurs and debates of the surrounding crowd—yet his heart grew peaceful.

The chess game had been laid bare; there was no longer any need for concealment.

He took a deep breath, about to speak, when the Saint suddenly raised her hand, silencing all commotion: "Everyone, withdraw. I wish to speak with this young friend Chen... alone."

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan's expression soured, yet he had no choice but to comply) Saint, this Chen Ji is after all a disciple of our Tianqing Sect—surely whatever business you have can be conducted in my presence—

(The Saint's voice turned icy cold) Ling Yuan, does what I choose to do require your approval?

text.content:
Ling Yuan shuddered, the oppressive pressure forcing him back three steps. His face turned ashen, yet he dared not provoke further. He could only wave his hand, signaling everyone to withdraw.

Soon, only Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Saint's battle chariot remained on the cliff platform. The bead curtain gently lifted, revealing a face of breathtaking cold beauty—purple eyes deep as an abyss, lips curved in an enigmatic half-smile.

The Demonic Path's Saint, Ji Wushuang.

The传闻中杀伐果断、心狠手辣的女魔头，此刻正以一种scrutinizing珍宝的目光打量着陈机。

Chen Ji met Ji Wushuang's gaze, every alarm in his heart ringing. This woman's cultivation was fathomlessly deep, her presence far exceeding his imagination. The question he had posed to Ling Yuan just moments ago had already exposed him completely under the dual scrutiny of the Tianqing Sect and the Demonic Path.

The seven-day agreement was now officially in effect. And apart from the Tianji Record's foresight ability, he now held another deadly piece of leverage—the relationship between Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path.

But could he actually play this card? And what kind of chain reaction would it trigger?

In the distance, Ye Qing's figure hid within the depths of the cloud sea, coldly observing everything. Her uncle, her enemy, her rival... all converged upon this "waste" Chen Ji at this moment.

The gears of destiny had begun to turn. And Chen Ji understood that every choice he made would determine the final outcome.
